_comment: LOCAL DEVELOPMENT FIXTURE. Every value here is fake and intentionally so.
Never copy this shape into a real deployment: production auth keys are
injected by DevOps and never live in a repo.
allowed_routes is an EXACT string match against the full request path --
no wildcards, no trailing slash, and the /telemetry prefix included. It is
enforced for API keys ONLY: a valid JWT reaches every authenticated route
regardless of what is listed here.
/metrics must be listed explicitly for a key that scrapes it.
jwtSecrets are HMAC shared secrets (HS256/HS384/HS512). Mint a local token
with bootstrap/mint-dev-jwt.sh. Only JWT-authenticated requests get an
event_header on the Redis payload -- API-key requests do not.
